items.value: Laptop, Tablet, Tent & Stand Mode】One device adapts to every situation. items: 【15.6" FHD Touchscreen & Powerful 8GB RAM + 256GB SSD】Interact intuitively and work efficiently. The vibrant 15.6-inch office laptop with Full HD touchscreen puts control at your fingertips—perfect for sketching, navigating, or playing games. Under the hood, the substantial 8GB RAM ensures smooth multitasking across apps and browser tabs, while the speedy 256GB SSD offers ample space for all your projects, movies, and music, with faster boot times and file access.

【Efficient Performance for Daily Tasks & Stylish Deep Purple Design】Powered for your everyday adventures. The Intel m3-8100Y processor delivers reliable performance for online classes, web browsing, document editing, and streaming. Housed in a sleek and unique Deep Purple chassis, this 2-in-1 business laptops doesn't just work well—it stands out with a bold, modern aesthetic that reflects your personal style.

【All-Day Battery Life & Comprehensive Connectivity】Laptop computer 2-in-1 8100y,your portable hub for work and play. The pc laptop with 38Wh battery supports hours of use, making it ideal for a full day of classes or cozy couch streaming sessions. Stay connected to all your peripherals with 3x USB 3.0 ports, HDMI output, Type-C data port, and more. Dual-band Wi-Fi 5 and Bluetooth 5.0 ensure stable wireless connections.

【Genuine Win 11 & Your Perfect Creative Companion】Ready to create and explore from the moment you open it. This 2-in-1 laptops comes with the genuine Win 11 pre-installed, offering a touch-optimized and secure experience. Whether you're a student taking digital notes, an artist sketching ideas, or a family enjoying movies, the AULA Flip Pro 360 is the versatile and stylish tool that evolves with your needs.
